SINGAPORE, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

Digital travel platform Agoda has revealed that travelers across Southeast Asia are increasingly looking to their neighbors for more accessible trips in the first half of 2026, with Vietnam standing out as the region's biggest draw.
A Region Exploring Its Own Neighbors

Vietnam recorded growth in accommodation search interest from every other Southeast Asian market across Indonesia (20%), Cambodia (22%), Laos (22%), Thailand (24%), Malaysia (40%), Singapore (52%), and the Philippines (98%). Agoda's flight booking data reflects the same shift, with Vietnam making its debut on the Philippines' top five outbound destinations in third place. The data highlights Vietnam's growing appeal as an accessible regional destination, driven by the market's expanding visa-free access, longer stay durations and increased flight connectivity.
Andrew Smith, Senior Vice President of Supply at Agoda

, said, "The first half of 2026 had its complexities, but what we saw is that travelers don't stop wanting to travel. They tend to shift toward destinations that are closer and easier to get to instead. Vietnam's growth within the region tells us that travelers respond decisively when you remove friction and lower the travel barriers."

Interest in Malaysia is also growing, particularly from Cambodia, where accommodation searches rose 24% and flight data shows Malaysia climbing from third to second place among Cambodia's outbound destinations. The growing momentum comes as Tourism Malaysia continues its promotional efforts in Cambodia this year as part of its broader Visit Malaysia 2026 campaign.

Search interest in Indonesia also grew among neighboring markets, climbing to #2 in Malaysia and #3 in Singapore, increasing 18% and 17% respectively. Combined with strong demand for affordable stays, particularly among travelers seeking accommodation priced below $50 a night, the findings point to both discovery and value as important drivers of regional travel interest.
Southeast Asia's Proximity Advantage

Agoda's traveler survey insights[1] revealed that nearly a third of travelers surveyed plan to take short trips of just one to three days in 2026, with Southeast Asia's proximity making it an ideal destination for quick getaways. Agoda's H1 2026 data reinforces this trend, as does its partnership with the ASEAN Secretariat on the 'SEABlings: Closer Than You Think' campaign, launched in August 2026 with AirAsia MOVE to inspire Southeast Asians to explore their own region.
Smith

added, "When planning a three-day getaway instead of a two-week vacation, travelers can travel more frequently, explore more destinations, and stay flexible with their budgets. Southeast Asia is well-positioned to capture this shift, with destinations close together and well-connected for more frequent, seamless travel."

Travelers looking to explore Southeast Asia can browse the full range of options on the Agoda travel platform, where flights, accommodation and experiences can be combined in a single booking, drawing on a network of over 130,000 flight routes, more than 6 million holiday properties, and over 300,000 activities. Travelers planning their next trip can find great value deals on Agoda's mobile app. Discover more on Agoda's mobile app or at Agoda.com.
